app_context: Synthesia2MIDI is a PySide6 desktop app that analyzes Synthesia piano videos, calibrates piano-key overlays, detects notes, downloads optional YouTube videos, and exports MIDI files.
ui_context: MIDI conversion and touch-up editor launch
instructions: Translate user-visible UI text naturally for native speakers.
Keep translations concise enough for buttons, labels, menus, and dialogs.
Preserve placeholders exactly, including braces and names.
Preserve URLs, file paths, file extensions, product names, and technical IDs.
Keep HTML tags and line-break structure valid.
Use notes only when a source string is ambiguous or needs product context.

required_output_schema.context: Qt context name copied from the packet entry
required_output_schema.source: English source text copied exactly from the packet entry
required_output_schema.notes: Optional translator note, otherwise empty string
